## Change

Describe the requested change and its scope.

## Checks

- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Browser checks pass for template, style, or JavaScript changes.
- [ ] Production output excludes drafts and private files.
- [ ] Existing URLs remain intact, or redirects cover the changes.
- [ ] The change excludes generated output and unrelated work.

## Visual review

Include desktop and mobile screenshots for layout changes.
